prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a steel vault cell with a wall of riveted dark iron plates behind her, a low steel ceiling, caged industrial lamps glowing on the wall, old iron tools hanging on the wall, a steel grate floor, dark and moody lamplight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Japanese woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, pale porcelain skin, deep smoky black eyeshadow blended far out beyond the eyes, a sharp black winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy black lips, sharply contoured cheekbones, a quietly weary look, heavy eyelids and a faint tension at the corners of her lips, soft pastel-pink hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes. Long almond nails, matte finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic — a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The color has dulled and cracked along her ribs, waist and thighs, rubbed bare in thin streaks over her shoulders and the backs of her knees so her skin shows through the worn paint. Dust and soot streak her temples and jaw, her lipstick is faded and smudged, dark smears run along her ribs, arms and shins, and her bare feet are caked with soot and grime.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring fixed directly onto a heavy iron plate bolted flat to the riveted iron wall high above her head on its own side, a little wider apart than her shoulders, the cuffs sitting snug against the plate, her arms stretched straight up. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring fixed directly onto a heavy iron plate bolted flat to the riveted iron wall just above the floor on its own side, the cuffs sitting snug against the plate, her feet shoulder-width apart.

Pose: standing with her back pressed flat against the riveted iron wall, facing the camera, her arms stretched straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, her bare feet shoulder-width apart flat on the floor, her head tipped slightly forward, her whole body sagging with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the floor, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.
